description: Read the portfolio an investment manager reported on SEC Form 13F for one quarter, largest reported value first: issuer and class as the manager wrote them, the company the security resolves to when an SEC filing ties them together (null otherwise, never guessed), shares, market value, the prior quarter's shares and the change. data.filings carries the filing with the manager's own summary totals and whether the loaded table adds up to them; data.periods lists the quarters on file. Pass holder as cik:<n>, or pass a manager name: one match returns its portfolio, several return the matching managers with their CIKs so you can pick. Use it when asked what a manager owns, or what it bought and sold in a quarter.

as_of.description: Knowledge date or timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339). The answer is what FinancialMD knew at that instant: only facts whose known interval contains as_of. Omit for the current view.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page (data.next_cursor).

holder.description: The manager: "cik:<n>" or a bare SEC CIK, or part of the manager's name as filed, such as "Berkshire Hathaway".

limit.description: Maximum number of periods or items to return (default 100, at most 1000).

period.description: Optional calendar quarter end (YYYY-03-31, -06-30, -09-30 or -12-31). Default: the newest quarter on file.

name: institutional_holdings

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: For one manager: { holder: { cik, name }, period, periods, filings: [{ accession, form, report_period, filed, amendment_type, source_url, entry_total, value_total, totals_match }], items: [position], next_cursor }. For a name with several matches: { items: [{ cik, name, latest }], next_cursor }.

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: A 13F manager's portfolio
